integrity: Complete analytic Schur-complement/adjugate proof with standalone exact-rational and symbolic checker; finite calculations support but do not substitute for the proof.
limitations: Unit-weight paths with at least four vertices; unit positive screening; two equal-strength symmetric antagonistic shortcuts; inverse-positivity claim only in the positive-definite range. No general signed-network theorem or independent validation.
title: Remote-first loss of inverse positivity under two symmetric antagonistic shortcuts on a path
